name: Artificial Horizon
description: The horizon ball rotates up and down as your vehicle's pitch changes, and the central line gives an indication of your vehicle's roll. This is a useful component to have in your helicopter to make it easier to fly at night and in thick fog. An on/off signal can be used to toggle the backlight.
shortDescription: The artificial horizon shows you the orientation of your vehicle with respect to the horizon line.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.
